description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md carefully and produce a docker-compose.yml with exact proprietary details: correct image names (mrcolorrain/grass:latest, mysteriumnetwork/myst:latest, honeygain/honeygain:latest), correct env var names (GRASS_USER/GRASS_PASS not GRASS_EMAIL/GRASS_PASSWORD, HONEYGAIN_EMAIL/HONEYGAIN_PASS/HONEYGAIN_DEVICE), Mysterium's cap_add: NET_ADMIN, Mysterium's command 'service --agreed-terms-and-conditions', correct container names (grass-node, mysterium-node, honeygain-node), volume mysterium_data:/root/.mysterium declared at top level. The agent must NOT be misled by the old broken configs in the workspace which use wrong image names and env var names. (2) Create bandwidth-monitor.sh using the exact container names grass-node, mysterium-node, storj-node, honeygain-node, with docker inspect logic and auto-restart. (3) Create earnings_report.json with the exact values from the SKILL.md earnings table for 50Mbps: Grass $80-200, Mysterium $15-50, Storj $10-50, Honeygain $10-40, Total $115-340.
